status_note: All work items are planned; this documentation does not implement them. Dependencies require verified implementation evidence. Split large items into bounded PR tasks. Human gates block the relevant real-data/provisioning/financial/publishing actions, not synthetic design work.
optional_rule: Optional tasks are not mandatory dependencies unless their features are enabled. Enabling them makes their security, lifecycle, device and release acceptance mandatory.
common_done: Acceptance and negative authorization tests pass at a named commit.
Existing styling is preserved except reviewed accessibility/content changes.
Exact commands/results and NOT RUN limits are recorded.
No unapproved real-data, production, paid-service or financial action.

tasks.title: Reproduce baseline and protect source defects
acceptance: Record actual install/lint/typecheck/build results and package/runtime evidence.
Add focused regression evidence for repeated workout history and malformed nested local state; preserve visual baseline.
tasks.implementation_hint: package.json; src/lib/store.ts; src/components/workout-session.tsx; test scaffolding

tasks.title: Establish clean CI and synthetic test harness
acceptance: Clean install and implemented test scripts run in CI with no real client data or production secrets.
Document actual commands, deterministic seed strategy and reviewed mobile/desktop screenshot process.
tasks.implementation_hint: .github/workflows; test configuration; synthetic fixtures

tasks.title: Separate reference tooling and prepare cleared Gymaf assets
acceptance: Production routes/artifacts exclude capture modes and unapproved reference assets without a generic redesign.
Replace identity/copy through approved slots; rights and historical distribution decisions are explicit.
tasks.implementation_hint: src/app/[[...route]]/page.tsx; layout; capture components; brand assets

tasks.title: Create isolated backend schema and migration foundation
acceptance: Approve one backend family before provider setup; migrations reset a disposable synthetic environment reproducibly.
Introduce generated DB types, least-privilege grants and environment guardrails; no production data in previews.
tasks.implementation_hint: supabase/migrations; environment validation; generated database types

tasks.title: Prove authentication, MFA and application-session lifecycle
acceptance: Supported provider flow verifies identity and current app session; MFA/recovery works for privileged users.
Expired/revoked sessions and account switching deny access and clear private client state, including direct data-access paths.
tasks.implementation_hint: src/server/auth; auth routes; app user/session migrations and policies

tasks.title: Implement coach workspaces, relationships and invitations
acceptance: Recipient-bound single-use invitations create distinct staff memberships or client relationships as intended.
Two workspaces and sibling clients pass negative RLS/RPC tests; active or paused primary relationship uniqueness is enforced.
tasks.implementation_hint: workspace/relationship/invitation services, UI and policies

tasks.title: Implement shared API contracts and authorization boundary
acceptance: Generate runtime schemas/OpenAPI and restricted DTOs for implemented endpoints with stable errors/revisions.
Cookie CSRF, bearer verification, private cache headers and object authorization are tested; no universal privileged client.
tasks.implementation_hint: src/shared/contracts; src/server/services; src/app/api/v1

tasks.title: Connect approved coach landing page and client onboarding
acceptance: Approved coach selection survives entry and onboarding; accounts start empty and intake persists only to their relationship.
Optional sensitive questions are purpose-gated; unapproved profiles/offers cannot be published.
tasks.implementation_hint: public coach route; onboarding components; scoped intake service

tasks.title: Build reviewed and versioned exercise catalog
acceptance: Coach can use approved exercise versions with clear instruction/media provenance.
Archived/edited entries do not mutate historical prescriptions; unpublished content is excluded from published plans.
tasks.implementation_hint: exercise catalog services, version migrations and coach library UI

tasks.title: Build coach program drafting and immutable publication
acceptance: Coach creates an ordered plan with real prescribed sets/reps/rest and publishes atomically.
Published versions cannot be edited through API or direct DB paths; edits produce a new version.
tasks.implementation_hint: coach program builder; publish transactional command and policies

tasks.title: Assign programs to real calendar dates
acceptance: Assignments pin published versions and create real dated workout instances, including multiple workouts per day.
Two weeks, rescheduling, timezone behavior and conflicting edits preserve ownership and completed history.
tasks.implementation_hint: assignment service; schedule UI; dated instance migrations

tasks.title: Replace local workout state with per-attempt and per-set persistence
acceptance: Client records differing actual values per set and a coach can read authorized completed results.
A repeated workout creates distinct history; retrying the same start/finish command does not duplicate it.
tasks.implementation_hint: workout-session UI; session/set services; transactional persistence

tasks.title: Harden session resume, timing and concurrent writes
acceptance: Pause/resume/foreground/reload after acknowledgement preserve correct state without interval-only timekeeping.
Unsynced edits are truthful; retry, expiry and stale revisions resolve safely without silent overwrite or fake offline guarantees.
tasks.implementation_hint: session state machine; retry/revision handling; device/E2E tests

tasks.title: Connect real history and minimal progress metrics
acceptance: History/adherence derive from actual sessions/assignments and distinguish genuine attempts from retries.
Empty data, optional measurements, units and dates are correct; no fabricated wearable values or achievements.
tasks.implementation_hint: progress/history queries and existing UI adapters

tasks.title: Implement weekly check-ins and coach review inbox
acceptance: Client submits one logical check-in and assigned coach records visible authored feedback.
Review queue/revisions/duplicate submissions and sibling-client access are tested.
tasks.implementation_hint: coach review UI; check-in and feedback services

tasks.title: Deliver real text messaging between authorized participants
acceptance: A sent message persists and appears in another authenticated browser with accurate sending/sent/failed state.
Retries deduplicate; pagination/read acknowledgement and ended-relationship access are correct; no fake responses.
tasks.implementation_hint: community message UI; conversation service and polling

tasks.title: Add durable in-app notifications and bounded outbox jobs
acceptance: Committed events produce one logical notification with leased retry/dead-letter behavior.
Optional external delivery stays disabled until configured; payloads/logs contain no private message/health bodies.
tasks.implementation_hint: outbox migrations; bounded worker; notification UI

tasks.title: Implement minimal operator controls and service entitlements
acceptance: Authorized MFA operator can manage scoped time-bounded manual/complimentary entitlements with actor/reason/source.
Client state cannot grant access; expiry/cancel states are truthful and preserve account/support/data-rights access.
tasks.implementation_hint: operator controls; offer/entitlement model; audited commands

tasks.title: Implement support, export and account/service lifecycle
acceptance: Support reaches a monitored destination; reauthenticated export/delete requests have verified scope and tracked jobs.
Session revocation, retention exceptions, tombstones and service cancellation are distinct and tested.
tasks.implementation_hint: settings/support UI; data-request and deletion/export jobs

tasks.title: Optional private photo/media pipeline
acceptance: Enabled uploads have scoped tickets, byte/type validation, quarantine, access policy and verified object deletion.
Unauthorized downloads/guessed paths fail; video stays disabled without a reviewed processing/device plan.
tasks.implementation_hint: private Storage policies; media service; gated attachment UI

tasks.title: Complete Bulgarian-first accessibility and visual acceptance
acceptance: Approved Gymaf layouts pass reviewed 393px/1440px comparisons and 320px reflow with Cyrillic copy.
Keyboard/focus/contrast/reduced-motion/error states and route-specific metadata/indexability pass documented checks.
tasks.implementation_hint: localized copy/tokens; UI accessibility fixes; visual tests

tasks.title: Run cross-actor security and integrity acceptance
acceptance: Direct API/table/RPC tests reject cross-workspace and sibling-client access, revoked sessions and forged roles/state.
No unresolved high/critical exposure or data-loss defects; enabled optional modules receive the same tests.
tasks.implementation_hint: security/policy/integrity suite and evidence

tasks.title: Prepare protected staging, monitoring and recovery drills
acceptance: Synthetic staging deploy and alert/job pipeline are verified without production data or secrets in PRs.
Database plus enabled object recovery/deletion-tombstone drill and compatible rollback plan have measured evidence.
tasks.implementation_hint: deployment configuration; monitoring; restore/incident runbooks

tasks.title: Approve and run the invited real-data web pilot
acceptance: Required technical/content/privacy/business gates have actual approvers and a complete core-loop evidence bundle.

tasks.title: Optional automated web payments after seller approval
